annotations.title: Add or complete customers (preview, then confirm)

description: Add customers, or fill in MISSING details of existing customers (matched by customer_id, account number or exact name). Nothing already recorded is overwritten. TWO STEPS: first call = preview + confirm_token; the change is only made on the second call with confirm_token. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

add_if_new.description: Add customers that do not exist yet (default false)

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

name.description: Customer name (a new customer is added when no existing one matches and add_if_new is true)

name: accounting_update_customers
